limits: No selected-case or manual acceptance pass from archive or control success.
Initial, expired/no prior or opaque hint, host, child protocol and different errors are not translated.
No secrets, operator input references, lifecycle secret IDs, URLs or private identity metadata are archived here.

policy.assertions: unchanged fresh mint, exact /Me identity active and protected200; AC6 real expiry controls unchanged
policy.classification: conditional typed signal to existing restore loop; not proof of transient cause
eligibility: prior unsigned JWT expiry hint still future
unchanged config hash, host, clientID and secret
policy.freshness: always call original producer; never return cached bearer after failure; server may return identical token text
policy.retry_owner: unchanged fresh_workspace_access90second absolute deadline,2second pauses,minremaining30seconds; no new retry loop
policy.scope: explicit injected RAM CredentialFactory; same producer/secret/profile/host/clientID with config hash before/after
policy.unmatched_errors: propagate unchanged; cancellation direct before post-check
